# Swiftscope

> Swiftscope (https://swiftscope.com.au) has two sides. (1) Quoting and job
> management software for Australian trade businesses -- electricians,
> plumbers, carpenters, roofers, builders and other trades: build and send
> professional quotes from your phone in minutes, mark up plans and
> drawings, manage jobs, and push draft invoices to Xero. Pricing is AUD
> $45/month flat with a 7-day free trial (no credit card). (2) A free public
> directory where homeowners find verified local tradies -- searchable by
> trade and suburb, with real Google ratings -- and request quotes for free.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://swiftscope.com.au/): product overview for tradies
- [Features](https://swiftscope.com.au/features): quoting, plan markup, AI drawing analysis, job management, Xero export
- [How it works](https://swiftscope.com.au/how-it-works): the quote-on-site workflow explained
- [Quoting software by trade](https://swiftscope.com.au/quoting-software): per-trade landing pages
- [Get quotes](https://swiftscope.com.au/get-quotes): homeowners describe a job and receive quotes from local tradies
- [Directory](https://swiftscope.com.au/directory): browse verified local trade businesses
- [Blog](https://swiftscope.com.au/blog): guides on quoting, pricing and running a trade business
- [Sign up](https://swiftscope.com.au/signup): start a 7-day free trial
- [Log in](https://swiftscope.com.au/login): existing account sign-in

## Directory URL patterns

- Trade in a suburb: `https://swiftscope.com.au/{trade-plural}-{suburb}-{state}` (e.g. `/electricians-seaford-vic`)
- All trades in a suburb: `https://swiftscope.com.au/tradies-in/{suburb}-{state}`
- A single business listing: `https://swiftscope.com.au/directory/{business-slug}`
- Full URL index: [sitemap](https://swiftscope.com.au/sitemap.xml)

## Free tools

- [Charge-out rate calculator](https://swiftscope.com.au/tools/charge-out-rate)

- [Vehicle running cost](https://swiftscope.com.au/tools/vehicle-cost)
- [DIY materials estimator](https://swiftscope.com.au/tools/diy-materials)

## For homeowners

Requesting quotes through Swiftscope is free. Browse the directory by trade
and suburb, compare Google ratings, then contact tradies directly or request
quotes.

## For trade businesses

Swiftscope replaces spreadsheets and paper quoting: price book import from
supplier CSVs, reusable job packages, margin controls, quote PDFs, digital
acceptance, and accounting export. Built for small teams of 1-10.
